request.query: What are the contraindications for Metformin?

response.query: What are the contraindications for Metformin?

evidence.publisher: U.S. National Library of Medicine / FDA
evidence.title: Metformin - Contraindications
evidence.text:
Drug: Metformin
Section: Contraindications

Severe renal impairment (eGFR < 30 mL/min/1.73m2), metabolic acidosis, acute or chronic DKA.

evidence.publisher: U.S. National Library of Medicine / FDA
evidence.title: Metformin - Use in Specific Populations
evidence.text:
Drug: Metformin
Section: Use in Specific Populations

Renal Impairment: Contraindicated in eGFR < 30 mL/min.

evidence.publisher: U.S. National Library of Medicine / FDA
evidence.title: Metformin - Warnings & Precautions
evidence.text:
Drug: Metformin
Section: Warnings & Precautions

Lactic acidosis, iodinated contrast imaging (hold metformin), Vitamin B12 deficiency (monitor every 2-3 years).
